description.en: Instantiate a template group into the active project's graph in one call: inner node/edge/group ids are remapped (same template can be instantiated repeatedly without collision), materialised as one __group__ top-level node (incl. nested sub-groups), returning the new groupId and stable in_N/out_N exposed ports (with semantic labels) for wiring. Prefer this over manual createNode+connect+createGroup expansion.

nameContains.description: 2026-07-15 新增：grep 式模糊过滤——按节点 name 子串（大小写不敏感）匹配，命中节点 + 其邻接边一起返回，返回值多一个 search:{matchCount} 告诉你到底命中了几个（0 命中时 nodes 是空数组，不会静默回退成全图）。图很大、只记得一个大概名字（比如叙事里的地点名）时用它，不用先 pipeline.get() 全图肉眼翻找。可以和 groupId/nodeIds 同时传，取并集。 / 2026-07-15: grep-style fuzzy filter — case-insensitive substring match on node name; matched nodes + their adjacent edges are returned, plus search:{matchCount} telling you exactly how many matched (0 matches → nodes is [], never a silent full-graph fallback). Use this instead of pulling the whole graph to eyeball a name. Can combine with groupId/nodeIds (union).

opIdIn.description: 2026-07-15 新增：按 opId 精确匹配任意一个（如 ["tree_merge"] 找所有 tree_merge 节点），行为同 nameContains（命中+邻接边，附带 search.matchCount）。 / 2026-07-15: exact match against any of the given opIds (e.g. ["tree_merge"] finds every tree_merge node); same behavior as nameContains (matches + adjacent edges, plus search.matchCount).

description.zh: 读取 scene pipeline：默认轻量摘要（id/opId/name + 边，无 params）；mode=hash 仅 hash；raw:true 才返回全图。instantiate 后用 groupId 按需核对；不确定具体 nodeId 时用 nameContains/opIdIn 做 grep 式模糊查找，不用每次都读全图。
description.en: Read scene pipeline: default lightweight summary (id/opId/name + edges, no params); mode=hash for hash only; raw:true for full graph. After instantiate, pass groupId to verify locally; when you don't know the exact nodeId, use nameContains/opIdIn for a grep-style fuzzy lookup instead of reading the whole graph every time.

ops.description:
支持的 op type：createNode / updateNode / deleteNode / connect / disconnect（删边；`deleteEdge` 是完全等价的别名，两个名字都可以用）/ setMetadata / createGroup / updateGroup / deleteGroup / ungroup / appendMergeItem（见下）。节点标识符字段名严格区分，不是别名，写错字段名会被当场拒绝（不会静默造出僵尸节点）：createNode/updateNode/deleteNode 用 `nodeId`（不是 `id`）；connect 的两端是 `source:{nodeId,port}` / `target:{nodeId,port}`（同样是 `nodeId`，不是 `id`），可选 `edgeId`（不是 `id`）；disconnect/deleteEdge 用 `edgeId`（不是 `id`）；createGroup/updateGroup/deleteGroup/ungroup 用 `groupId`（不是 `id`）。例：{"type":"createNode","nodeId":"seed","opId":"seed_control","params":{}}；删边例：{"type":"disconnect","edgeId":"e_xxx"}。任何不在上述 type 列表里的值都会被显式拒绝（带 opIndex 的校验错误），不会被静默跳过——不要因为某个 op type 没试过就假设它不存在或改用变通方案（如给同一端口接双输入、删组重建），先看这份类型列表。2026-07-01 复盘：此前用错字段名会被静默忽略/静默造出 id 为 undefined 的僵尸节点，现在会返回带 opIndex 的显式校验错误。

2026-07-15 新增两项能力：
(1) connect 的 source.port / target.port 除了字符串 `in_N`/`out_N` 外，还可以写 `{"label":"IslandName"}` —— 用 instantiateTemplate 返回的 exposedInputs/exposedOutputs 里那个语义 label（如 "Scene"/"Rest"/"Island"），由后端查该组当前的 exposedInputs/exposedOutputs 解出真实 portName 再真正连线。优先用 label，不用在 in_N/out_N 和语义名之间自己心算映射；label 找不到或匹配到多个端口会显式报错并列出该组全部可用 label，不会静默连错。例：{"type":"connect","source":{"nodeId":"g1","port":{"label":"Island"}},"target":{"nodeId":"g2","port":{"label":"Scene"}}}。
(2) appendMergeItem：往一个 tree_merge（典型是根节点 aw_m0_merge）追加一路内容，不用自己先读 portCount、算 item_N、再分两步 updateNode+connect——一次 op 搞定：{"type":"appendMergeItem","mergeNodeId":"aw_m0_merge","source":{"nodeId":"g1","port":"out_0"}}（source.port 同样可以用 {"label":...}）。同一批 ops 里连续写多个 appendMergeItem（哪怕都指向同一个 mergeNodeId）会正确地依次递增 item 号，不会重复用同一个槎位。mergeNodeId 必须已经存在且 opId 是 tree_merge，否则显式报错。 / Supported op types: createNode / updateNode / deleteNode / connect / disconnect (delete an edge; `deleteEdge` is a fully equivalent alias, both spellings work) / setMetadata / createGroup / updateGroup / deleteGroup / ungroup / appendMergeItem (see below). Node/edge/group identifier field names are STRICT, not aliases — using the wrong one is now rejected outright (never silently produces a zombie node). createNode/updateNode/deleteNode use `nodeId` (not `id`); connect's endpoints are `source:{nodeId,port}` / `target:{nodeId,port}` (also `nodeId`, not `id`), with an optional `edgeId` (not `id`); disconnect/deleteEdge use `edgeId` (not `id`); createGroup/updateGroup/deleteGroup/ungroup use `groupId` (not `id`). Example: {"type":"createNode","nodeId":"seed","opId":"seed_control","params":{}}; delete-edge example: {"type":"disconnect","edgeId":"e_xxx"}. Any type not in this list is rejected explicitly (opIndex-addressed validation error), never silently skipped — do not assume an op type doesn't exist just because you haven't tried it, or fall back to workarounds (dual-input on one port, delete+re-instantiate groups) before checking this type list. 2026-07-01 postmortem: using the wrong field name used to be silently ignored / silently created an undefined-id zombie node — it now returns an explicit, opIndex-addressed validation error instead.

Two new capabilities added 2026-07-15:
(1) connect's source.port/target.port can now be `{"label":"IslandName"}` instead of a raw `in_N`/`out_N` string — the semantic label from instantiateTemplate's exposedInputs/exposedOutputs (e.g. "Scene"/"Rest"/"Island"); the backend resolves it against that group's CURRENT exposedInputs/exposedOutputs into the real portName before wiring. Prefer label addressing over mentally mapping in_N/out_N yourself; an unknown or ambiguous label is rejected explicitly with the full list of that group's available labels, never silently mis-wired. Example: {"type":"connect","source":{"nodeId":"g1","port":{"label":"Island"}},"target":{"nodeId":"g2","port":{"label":"Scene"}}}.
(2) appendMergeItem: append one more content source into a tree_merge (typically the root aw_m0_merge) without first reading its portCount, computing the next item_N, and issuing updateNode+connect yourself — one op does it all: {"type":"appendMergeItem","mergeNodeId":"aw_m0_merge","source":{"nodeId":"g1","port":"out_0"}} (source.port also accepts {"label":...}). Multiple appendMergeItem ops in the same batch (even targeting the same mergeNodeId) correctly increment sequentially, never reusing an item slot. mergeNodeId must already exist and be opId tree_merge, or it's rejected explicitly.

description.zh: 批量修改 scene pipeline graph
description.en: Apply a batch of scene pipeline graph edits

projectId.description: 目标 scene 项目 id；AI 须先 scene:projects.open / target project id; AI must scene:projects.open first

raw.description: 默认 false：只返回轻量摘要（status + 各节点端口的 children 名/cell 数等），可放心整图 execute 看摘要验证每组是否产出。仅在极少数需要原始全量 voxel cells 时传 true（体积巨大，会撑爆上下文）。

narrativeLocationNames.description: 2026-07-01 新增：硬门控 stage3.location_names。传入上游叙事节点树/契约里每一个地点的原样 name（如「望江客栈」「市集」「清水镇」），本次 execute 会核对最终场景节点名是否逐个包含这些名字，结果写进返回值 verification.locationNameAlignment（{ok, missing:[{name,reason}]}），未命中会连同 verification.hints 一起给出可直接照做的缺项清单。仅 raw:false 时生效；不传该字段则完全不跑这项校验（默认关闭，不影响非 Sino/无上游契约的调用方）。

description.zh: 执行当前 scene pipeline 或指定节点；默认返回轻量摘要（status + 各端口 children 名/cell 数），raw:true 才返回全量；传 narrativeLocationNames 可顺带核对场景节点名与上游叙事地点名是否对齐（stage3.location_names 硬门控）。2026-07-15 新增：非 raw 模式下每次都会顺带跑三项拓扑检测（Rest/Scene 并行 fan-out、非法局部 tree_merge、manual_points 静默 (0,0) 默认），结果在 verification.topologyIssues 里——前两类（fan-out/局部 merge）从来没有合法的施工中间态，一旦出现会直接抛错并附带可执行的 suggestedOps（能算的情况下），不用等到下一轮才发现接错了；第三类只是提示，不阻断。不要看到 status:completed 就以为万事大吉，topologyIssues 非空也要处理。
description.en: Execute the active scene pipeline or a single node; returns a lightweight summary by default (status + per-port child names / cell counts), pass raw:true for the full result; pass narrativeLocationNames to additionally gate scene node names against the upstream narrative location names (stage3.location_names). 2026-07-15: non-raw mode now also runs three topology checks every call (Rest/Scene parallel fan-out, illegal local tree_merge, manual_points silent (0,0) default), surfaced under verification.topologyIssues — the first two (fan-out / local merge) are NEVER a legitimate mid-construction state, so hitting either throws immediately with ready-to-use suggestedOps when computable, instead of only finding out a round later; the third is advisory only, non-blocking. Do not treat status:completed as 'done' without also checking topologyIssues.

gameSlug.description: 目标游戏 slug（绑定 <projectRoot>/.forgeax/games/<gameSlug>/textures/ 作为资产源）

projectRoot.description: 场景侧 host 项目根（默认=本工具 cwd）。返回 dir 供反推后传给 asset2d:publishToGame 的 projectRoot。

description.zh: 把共享游戏沙箱 <projectRoot>/.forgeax/games/<gameSlug>/textures/ 绑定为资产源。跨 workbench 发布时**先调本工具**（返回 dir），从 dir 反推 projectRoot 再传给 asset2d:publishToGame——两 workbench 默认 cwd 不同，顺序反了会落错目录、library.list 搜不到。绑定后广播 library:changed。
description.en: Bind the shared game sandbox <projectRoot>/.forgeax/games/<gameSlug>/textures/ as an asset source. When publishing across workbenches, call this FIRST (returns dir), derive projectRoot from dir, then pass the same projectRoot to asset2d:publishToGame — the two workbench default cwds differ; reversing the order lands bytes where the scene can't read them. Broadcasts library:changed on bind.

assetName.description: field4 语义名 / item-name the renderer matches on

from2dAlias.description: ★推荐：2D 生成资产的 alias（asset2d:assets.list/getBytes 返回的那个）。发布桥会 server-to-server 取字节，agent 不必、也不要传 base64。

from2dBlobId.description: 可选：2D 资产 blobId（同时作 sourceBlobId 幂等键）；from2dAlias 优先。

dataBase64.description: （回退用）base64 PNG 字节。优先用 from2dAlias 让发布桥自取——base64 经上下文会被自动压缩丢弃、引发发布死循环。

autotileKind.description: autotile rule alias, required for tile (e.g. common_16)

sourceBlobId.description: provenance / idempotency key（给了 from2dBlobId 会自动填）

description.zh: 【已退役为兼容回退，新任务请用 asset2d:publishToGame + scene:library.useGameTextures 走共享沙箱】贴图发布桥：把 2D 生成的 PNG 发布进当前场景项目私有 raw 库（合成 renderer alias、tile 绑定 autotile 规则、记录 provenance、幂等）。如仍用：只传 from2dAlias（+tile 的 autotileKind）让桥 server-to-server 自取字节；别把 base64 塞进上下文（会被压缩丢失→死循环）。
description.en: [LEGACY fallback — new work should use asset2d:publishToGame + scene:library.useGameTextures (shared sandbox)] Texture publish bridge: publish a 2D-generated PNG into the active scene project's private raw library. If still used: pass from2dAlias (+autotileKind for tiles) so the bridge fetches bytes server-to-server; NEVER push base64 through the agent context (it gets compacted away → publish loops).
